provenance.source_text: This duty arises under section 9815 of this title.

_note: Proves host_section_numbers is actually threaded through cross_reference_links() (not only resolve_references() directly) — section 9815 IS in host_section_numbers, so the link's own object is the INTERNAL pinpoint '§ 9815'. Without the wiring, cross_reference_links() silently drops host_section_numbers (it is never a parameter), so the resolver falls back to host_section_numbers=None and produces the EXTERNAL object '31 U.S.C.|§ 9815' instead.
